recipe.visualDefinition: A man in a vibrant pink blazer sits comfortably in the crook of a large, textured tree branch, surrounded by various exotic and domestic birds. The scene is set in a sun-drenched outdoor field with a soft-focus background, utilizing high-saturation 1950s film aesthetics.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal line of the tree branch bisects the frame, supporting the subject.
The vibrant pink of the blazer contrasts sharply against the natural greens and browns.
The subject's relaxed posture and interaction with the owl create a whimsical, staged narrative.
Typography is anchored in the lower-left negative space created by the branch's elevation.
coreInvariants: High-saturation color palette with a focus on magenta/pink.
Presence of multiple bird species in a single frame.
Mid-century film grain and soft-focus depth of field.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated in the upper-right quadrant, scaled to occupy approximately one-third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick, textured tree branch serves as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the branch from the bottom right up to the subject, then moves down to the text block in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large area of soft-focus grass in the lower-left quadrant provides a clean canvas for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Natural earth tones (brown, olive green) in the background and tree.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant magenta-pink of the subject's jacket.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Primary blue and deep red used in the display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground elements with lower value/muted tones in the distant background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or digital-looking colors; stick to Kodachrome-inspired primaries.

letterConstructionRules: Heavyweight, blocky lowercase letters for primary display.
Uniform stroke width in the sans-serif elements.
High-contrast, slanted cursive for connecting words.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'r' with a short, blunt ear.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the blurred grass background

composition.position: Left of the second display line

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric sans-serif paired with a delicate, traditional script for a mid-century commercial look.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and heavyweight lowercase feel.
Provides the necessary calligraphic contrast for the connecting words.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1950s style photograph of a man in a bright pink suit jacket sitting on a thick tree branch in a park. He is looking at an owl perched on the branch. Other birds like parrots and crows are scattered on the tree. The background is a soft-focus green field under bright daylight.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of left-aligned text in the lower-left corner. Line 1: Large bold blue lowercase sans-serif. Line 2: Small black script followed by large bold red lowercase sans-serif. Line 3: Medium black uppercase sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the jacket a vibrant magenta-pink?
Are the birds integrated naturally into the tree scene?
Is the typography left-aligned in the negative space?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the man's interaction with the birds feels intentional.
Check that the text does not overlap the tree branch.
Verify the 1950s color grading is consistent across the image.
Confirm the lowercase 'r' in the display text has the correct geometric profile.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in [Vibrant Color Clothing] + [Surreal Natural Setting] + [Exotic Animals] + [Geometric Sans-Serif Typography in Primary Colors]
